lines.text: I'm two years old, a full-grown dude
One little thought and a real good mood
They named me from a meme one day
Now I'm Chmeezus. Anyway...
I found a wire, I found some string
That straw cleaner? Sacred thing
I'm Chmeeze, take it easy
Got one brain cell riding the breeze
Call me Chmeezus, king of noon
I found my purpose in a plastic spoon
Give you a headbutt, lean into you
I love my people. That's what I do
Three whole hours with a plastic spoon
I moved the sun across the room
I knocked it left, I chased it right
I think I brought mankind the light
No soup, no answers, no grand plan
Just honest work from a full-grown man
Your AirPods needed somewhere new
I helped them down. That's love, dude
I walk so close you lose your stride
Just making sure I'm by your side
Door swings open—I have been freed!
This stretch of carpet's all I need
You pick me up, I don't resist
Same time tomorrow? I'm into this
Sometimes I find you where you are
And start my little motorcar
No spoon, no kingdom, nothing to prove
I'm soft and warm and home with you
I'm Chmeeze, take it easy
Got one brain cell riding the breeze
Call me Chmeezus, king of noon
I found my purpose in a plastic spoon
Give you a headbutt, lean into you
I love my people. That's what I do

unalignedLines.text: Door swings open, out I slide
No idea what's on this side
You scoop me up—I start to purr
Pretty good trip, that's for sure
